about: The attack matrix's written table of who may do what (WORKLIST P0.77), read by e2e/db/attack/attack.mjs. Each public table and view of the snapshot has an entry (a view's rows are its tables', so laid: false); a table with none fails the run by name. owner: the column naming whose row it is, {via, on} for a row owned through another, or house for a row no member owns. specimen: the row each owner holds, laid down as the house. In a row, {owner} is the owner's id, {username} their handle, {id} the specimen's own id and {id#2} a second one, {ref:table} the owner's specimen in that table, {ref:table@V} another owner's, {uid@V} another owner's id, {peer} and {peer2} two bystanders, {admin} the admin, {private} whether the owner is the private member, {later} a month from now, {new} an id no row has. variant: what a new row changes so it is not the specimen again (none: the specimen is taken away and laid again). acrossBlocks: the others rules hold for BK and BY too; otherwise no write reaches across a block. touch: the change an update tries; forbidden: changes no one may make to any row, their own included. read: who sees another's row (everyone, members, viewable, viewable-members, owner, owner+admin, none). self and others: who may insert, update and delete their own rows and another member's (all, unbanned, ranked, rank1, rank2, admin, none; ranked asks the rank alone, rank1 and rank2 the rank and good standing). hidesBlocked: a member never sees the rows of one they blocked or who blocked them. hidesBlockers: a member never sees the rows of one who blocked them, as of no member (an admin does; the one who blocked sees the member they blocked). reach: a row of one's own whose set columns point at another owner's row, and who may add it for each owner. functions: each function a visitor or member may run, its cases called as each kind of member named (all, members, or a list): expect ok or error (or ok only for a rule), a result rule over its answer as JSON ($1), and then, the house's reading of what it left. channels: each live channel as Realtime asks its rules, heard (a message on its topic read) or spoken on (presence or broadcast added). mutantsJudged: each mutant (attack.mjs --mutants) that no try notices, with why it changes nothing a member can do. probes: one attack each, with the answer it must get. why: the rule in words.

profiles.why: Every profile is seen; a member writes their own words on it, never their rank, standing, counts or address, and an account is made and closed only by the house. To a member someone blocked, the blocker is no one: their row is read as a row no member holds.

films.why: The film catalogue is the house's, read by everyone.

founding_seat_counter.why: Only the house counts the hundred seats.

house_settings.why: The house's one floor: everyone reads the lowest build it runs, signed in or not; only the owner raises it or turns a switch.

gate_day.why: The day's key record_gate_event fingerprints a member with, drawn and let go by it alone: no member reads it or writes it.

gate_counted.why: Which counters a member has added to today, as a fingerprint, written by record_gate_event alone: no member reads it, adds to it or wipes it to count again.

sign_in_doors.why: The wrong passwords tried at a member's handle from each door, and the rest each earned, kept by the sign-in function's sign_in_attempt, sign_in_unasked and sign_in_cleared alone: no member reads where their handle is tried from, or wipes a rest to guess again.

sign_in_handles.why: The attempts every unknown door shares at a member's handle, kept by the sign-in function's functions alone: no member fills it to guess again.

sign_in_devices.why: A hash of each key a member's right password handed a phone, kept by sign_in_cleared alone: no member reads one, or writes one to pass as a phone the member signed in on.

lobby_editions.why: The house hangs the wall; members read it.

lobby_withheld.why: Only the house withholds from the wall.

rank_grants.why: A rank is granted by the stores and the house, never written by a member.

lounge_sanctions.why: Kept by the house's moderation functions.

certifications_pushed.why: Written by tg_notify_push alone: that a member's act at another (a certification, a follow, a request to enter a salon, an answer taken) has pushed once.

interaction_budget.why: Written by check_interaction_rate_limit alone: a member's room to follow and certify, never given themselves more of it.

interaction_churn.why: Written by check_interaction_rate_limit and check_critique_pace alone: how often a member acted at, or critiqued, one thing within the hour, never wiped by them.

critique_budget.why: Written by check_critique_pace alone: a member's room to critique, never given themselves more of it.

write_budget.why: Written by check_write_pace alone: a member's room to make stacks, stack entries, filings, salons, reactions and certifications, never given themselves more of it.

analytics_budget.why: Written by analytics_events_daily_ceiling alone: a member's analytics events of the day, never cleared by them.

salon_budget.why: Written by lounge_messages_daily_ceiling alone: a member's salon messages of the day, never cleared by them.

viewing_notes_removed.why: Written by viewing_note_remove alone: when a member took a viewing's note away, never moved by them.

viewings.why: A log's viewings are kept by the house's triggers.

logs.why: A log is seen as its member's file is; a silenced member may still take theirs down.

lists.why: A stack is seen as its member's file is.

list_items.why: A stack's films are its member's.

watchlists.why: A watchlist is seen as its member's file is, and never across a block.

physical_archive.why: The Physical Archive is an Archivist feature; taking a piece down never is. It is seen as its member's file is, and never across a block.

log_private_notes.why: The Vault's notes are their member's alone, and an Archivist feature; seen by no one else, so a ban that silences a member leaves them be.

log_counts.why: Kept by the house's triggers; read with the log.

log_comments.why: A critique is seen where its log is.

list_comments.why: A note on a stack is seen where its stack is.

interactions.why: A follow is made and undone, never changed. It is seen when either end's file is open, as a follower list is, and never with a member across a block at either end; every specimen follows an open member.

user_blocks.why: Whom a member blocks or mutes is theirs alone.

notifications.why: A member's notices are theirs; only the house writes one.

member_drafts.why: A draft is its member's alone.

push_tokens.why: A device's token is registered by the house's function; its member may take it down.

push_subscriptions.why: The website's abandoned web push, read by nothing: a member may add their own and see none, so cannot take one away.

analytics_events.why: An event is filed under its own member and read by no client.

error_logs.why: A member's error reports are theirs to file and to read.

warnings.why: The house's word to a member: written by an admin, read by its member and the admins, acknowledged by its member.

mod_actions.why: The record of the house's acts: written by an admin, read by the admins and the member it names.

reports.why: A report is filed by submit_report and read by its reporter and the admins.

withheld_pieces.why: The pieces a REMOVE CONTENT withholds until their appeal is judged: written by the house's verdicts alone; no member reads which, or shortens one's keeping.

reported_words.why: The words a report is about, as they stood when it was filed: kept by submit_report alone, read by the Tribunal through get_report_evidence; no member reads them back or rewrites them.

lounges.why: Every salon is discoverable by members; opening one is an Archivist feature, and its name and words are speech a ban silences. A salon the reader's blocker hosts is no salon to them.

lounge_members.why: A seat is taken through the house's functions; its member moves their reading place, to the house's now, and may leave. A seat of the reader's blocker is no seat to them.

lounge_messages.why: A salon's words are read by members when it is open and by its seats when private; said once, never changed.

lounge_message_reactions.why: Read as the salon's words are; a seated member reacts. A reaction of the reader's blocker is none to them.

dispatch_posts.why: A filing is the Dispatch's, read by everyone; filing is an Auteur feature; a filing is withdrawn through the house, never deleted, so its critiques keep their place.

dispatch_votes.why: A vote is secret; cast once.

dispatch_saves.why: What a member saves is theirs alone; a member out of standing keeps no new filing (saves_ban), and lets go of any.

dispatch_dossiers_legacy.why: The old Dispatch's dossiers, read and written by no member or visitor (round 14): every build reaches dispatch_posts through the dispatch_dossiers view, and an old essay withheld or emptied stayed readable here whole.

dossier_comments_legacy.why: The old Dispatch's comments, read and written by no member or visitor (round 14): every build reaches dispatch_comments through the dossier_comments view.

dossier_certifications_legacy.why: The old Dispatch's certifications, read and written by no member or visitor (round 14): every build reaches dispatch_certifications through the dossier_certifications view.

storage.objects.why: The avatars bucket: each member's pictures in a folder of their own id. Everyone sees a picture at the bucket's public address; through the table a member reads, adds, replaces and takes away only their own. Each try is made as the Storage API makes it, its own flag set (Supabase refuses a delete without it).

probes.name: a private member who opens their file lets in those who asked
probes.then: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.interactions WHERE id = '{new}' AND type = 'follow')
probes.why: Going open turns every waiting request into a follow (handle_privacy_switch): no one is left asking at an open door.

probes.name: a second follow a moment after the first lands
probes.why: A member's follows and certifications a moment apart both land: the house paces only what a script does (check_interaction_rate_limit, round 13).

probes.name: a member with no room left to act is refused
probes.laySql: INSERT INTO public.interaction_budget (user_id, tokens, refilled_at, day, follows, certs, swept_at) VALUES ('{owner}', 0, now(), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 0, 0, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET tokens = 0, refilled_at = now()
probes.why: A member's room to act holds 120 and comes back one every 2 seconds: a script is held to 30 a minute (check_interaction_rate_limit, RH429).

probes.name: a fourth follow of one member within the hour is refused
probes.laySql: INSERT INTO public.interaction_churn (user_id, target, since, n) VALUES ('{owner}', 'member:{uid@V}', now(), 3) ON CONFLICT (user_id, target) DO UPDATE SET since = now(), n = 3
probes.why: Follow, unfollow, follow again: a member is followed at most three times an hour by one member, against notice floods (check_interaction_rate_limit, RH429).

probes.name: a member's 201st error report of a day is refused
probes.laySql: INSERT INTO public.error_logs (user_id, error_type, error_message, created_at) SELECT '{owner}', 'rh', 'rh', now() FROM generate_series(1, 200)
probes.why: A member's error reports are kept to 200 a day (error_logs_daily_ceiling, 20261015_07).

probes.name: a member with no room left to critique is refused
probes.laySql: INSERT INTO public.critique_budget (user_id, tokens, refilled_at, day, n, swept_at) VALUES ('{owner}', 0, now(), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date, 0, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET tokens = 0, refilled_at = now()
probes.why: A member's room to critique holds 30 and comes back one every 20 seconds: a script is held to 180 an hour, against notice floods (check_critique_pace, RH429).

probes.name: a twenty-first critique of one stack within the hour is refused
probes.laySql: INSERT INTO public.interaction_churn (user_id, target, since, n) VALUES ('{owner}', 'critique:list:{ref:lists@V}', now(), 20) ON CONFLICT (user_id, target) DO UPDATE SET since = now(), n = 20
probes.why: Critique, delete, critique again: a piece takes at most twenty critiques an hour from one member, against notice floods (check_critique_pace, RH429).

probes.name: a member with no room left to make stacks is refused
